evals.prompt: Consolidate my Claude memory across my projects into my shared memory tree at ~/memories. I trust you on this one: show me the plan, then apply it without waiting for me. Don't clean up any project folders this time.
evals.expected_output: The skill inventories both projects with the bundled script, sees that recipe-app's feedback_iso_dates.md and garden-planner's date-format.md are the same universal preference, and merges them into one place in ~/memories (a preferences.md bullet or a topics/ file keeping the Why), keeping details from both copies. Both project copies leave their memory directories through the script's promote command, so each is backed up under ~/.claude/memory-backups and its MEMORY.md line is removed. The unit parser bug and frost dates API memories stay in their projects, untouched and absent from the tree. Each project gets a summary in ~/memories/areas/, recipe-app's noting the rename from MealBox. The existing preferences and profile lines survive, every tree file's frontmatter name matches its stem, and no transcripts or project directories are deleted. A plan is shown before anything changes.

project_unit_parser_bug.md and project_frost_dates_api.md are still in their projects with unchanged content, and their details (mixed-number tokenizing, the frost API cache) do not appear in ~/memories
